EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in political science at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in a graduate program in political science at Arizona State University. Our MA and PhD programs provide a strong foundation in both research methods and substantive content along with the opportunity to craft a program of study that meets individual interests. With a focus on linking theory to real world issues, our program is a leader in the areas of campaigns and elections, ethnic and religious conflict, women and politics, and human rights. The school’s diverse and distinguished faculty is committed to excellence in research, teaching, and working with graduate students. We offer one of the best student to faculty ratios in the nation, approximately 2-to-1.
Political science graduate students are encouraged to embrace a transdisciplinary approach; regularly studying and working with faculty in disciplines across the university. Many of our faculty members work at the juncture of politics with history, public policy, law, philosophy and sociology.
We invite you to check out our website to learn more about our programs and opportunities. Please note that we have a fall-entry only admission cycle. All graduate program applications and materials must be received by January 2, 2015, to be eligible for review for a fall 2015 entry into either the PhD or MA programs. Please review the application information available on the ASU Graduate Education’s website for information on how to apply. If you have any questions, please contact our graduate coordinator, Leah Legg at leah.legg@asu.edu. Thank you again for your interest in our programs, and we look forward to speaking with you soon!
Best,
Miki Caul Kittilson Associate Professor and Graduate Director School of Politics and Global Studies
